name: 티로
face: 입을 크게 벌리고 혀를 내민 표정
silhouette: 작은 체구, 삐죽한 머리, 좌우로 흔들리는 듯한 꼬리, 튀어나온 혀
visual_en: A tiny 2-head tall goblin-like creature facing right. The head features spiky dark purple hair with a small white bone ornament on top and bright yellow glowing eyes with a long pink tongue sticking out. The body is a small, agile frame wearing a simple dark teal leather vest. A short, chubby purple tail sways energetically behind. The overall silhouette is compact and sharp, designed to stand out against dark dungeon floors with its bright yellow eye and light purple skin.
pose_en: Swaying rapidly from side to side while running forward
vfx_en: Short, faint purple motion streaks following the movement
lore: 가장 빠른 떼 몹. 좌우로 흔들며 몰려온다. 보스 볼케 형제가 불러내는 졸개로도 나온다.
